news.title: Purdue MEM Students work with Egyptian diagnostics startup Reme-D to build scalable customer support system
news.summary_en: A team of students in Purdue University’s Master of Engineering Management (MEM) program partnered with Egyptian diagnostics startup Reme-D to develop a customer feedback and support system designed to improve communication, streamline issue resolution and support the company's continued growth across the Middle East and Africa.

news.title: Innovation, collaboration help engineering student build confidence in the classroom and on the track
news.summary_en: Sometimes a child’s toy can lead to inspiration for where to go to college. That’s what happened to Youssuf Elhawary, who’s originally from Cairo, Egypt.

news.title: Purdue MEM students partner with EatCloud to expand food rescue through AI-powered WhatsApp solution
news.summary_en: A team of students in Purdue University’s Master of Engineering Management (MEM) program partnered with Colombia-based social enterprise EatCloud to develop technology solutions aimed at reducing food waste while expanding access to food for communities in need.
